[Act: income-tax-2025
 Chapter: Special Provisions Relating to Certain Persons
 Section: 324::Charge of tax in case of a firm.
]


In the case of a firm which is assessable as a firm, tax shall be charged on its total income at the rate as specified in any Central Act for relevant tax year.
